purpose: Teach: 追い込ま/役に立た/内定/対価/昇格/年数/クオリティ/安値

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 追い込まれた時こそ、経営者の真価が、問われる。
lines.en: It's in moments like these—when you're backed into a corner—that a leader's true character is revealed.
lines.style: Measured, philosophical opening. Slight pause at the em-dash. Calm, unhurried delivery. The weight of decades of observation in each phrase. Not lecturing—sharing hard-won wisdom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。役に立たない過去の慣習、見直しております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm reviewing those outdated practices that no longer serve us.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Clear, direct affirmation. Slight lift on 'reviewing'—showing active engagement, not passive agreement. Formal but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時から、内定者の研修、私が立ち会った。
lines.en: From the company's founding, I attended every new hire's training myself.
lines.style: Quiet nostalgia, not sadness. Slower pace on the opening. Memory living in the voice. A gentle reminder of what was built, held with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員の汗の対価として、待遇、充実させます。
lines.en: Yes. I intend to ensure that our staff's hard work translates directly into better compensation and benefits.
lines.style: Calm conviction. Measured pace. 'Ensure' carries quiet determination—not a promise made lightly. Respectful but resolute.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若手の昇格、思い切って、進めることだ。
lines.en: Don't hesitate with promotions for your younger staff. Be bold.
lines.style: Sharp and direct. No softening. The weight of a directive from someone who's earned the right to give it. Brief, clear, commanding without harshness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業からの年数、社員と、共に重ねております。
lines.en: Yes. Over all these years since our founding, I've walked this path together with our people.
lines.style: Steady, grounded tone. Emphasis on 'together'—showing shared journey, not unilateral decision. Respectful pacing. Building toward commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時のクオリティへのこだわり、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't lose sight of the standards we held from the beginning. That commitment to quality is who we are.
lines.style: Sharp, final wisdom. Slight intensity on 'don't forget.' Not a suggestion—an anchor point. Calm but unmissable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。安値路線、当社の、選択肢ではありません。
lines.en: Yes. Cutting corners with cheap pricing was never—and will never be—an option for us.
lines.style: Quiet, unshakeable conviction. Steady, deliberate pacing. Small emphasis on 'never'—not emphatic, just immovable. A closing statement that settles the matter.
